value.rationale: The finite-width realization of the recently studied maximal triangular hard-core model has competing commensurate extremes at 2/5 and 2/3 occupied sites per rung, accompanied by exact degeneracies and fractional 1/5 and 1/3 activity corrections. These precise state-counting and asymptotic facts offer a reproducible benchmark for constrained-lattice models and show how a one-dimensional strip avoids the planar phase coexistence mechanism. This is a complete natural width-two classification, not an arbitrary coefficient or a general claim about all strips.
